title: Climb Monte Toro and see the whole island
description: 358 metres, the highest point on Menorca, and from the top you see the island from sea to sea: Maó on one side, Ciutadella on the other, both coasts at once. Up there are the sanctuary of the Mare de Déu del Toro and a terrace for coffee. You drive up a winding road; on a clear autumn day it is the best map of Menorca there is.
imageAlt: The view from the top of El Toro: the island's interior and villages in the distance
